text:
lina: Quick flag 10: our Weekly KPI deck's 'Inbound by Campaign' tile vs. the detailed dashboard mismatch again. Tile shows webinar contribution at 3.2% of total leads for last week, but the drilldown dashboard claims 18%.

matt: Oh no, not again. Which tile are you referring to? the top-left one on the weekly deck (slide 4)?

lina: Yep slide 4, the small stacked bar. Looks like the slide is pulling Last-Touch from the BI export; the dashboard is a Multi-Touch linear model.

oscar: We changed the BI export to Last-Touch to make the deck lighter and faster. But the dashboard team kept multi-touch for accuracy. We should standardize.

priya: For tomorrow's KPI review let's do three quick things: (1) show the dashboard multi-touch numbers, (2) explain why slide uses last-touch (speed), and (3) propose a normalization: annotate deck with a tooltip that lists both numbers and a short note on methodology.

analytics-bot: FYI: sample_rate logs show GA->BI pipeline dropped from 100% to 5% for 72 hours starting 2025-09-12 due to a streaming quota throttle. That affects weekly comparisons and explains some of the undercounting in the deck export. Full details: gs://redwood-analytics/logs/sampler-2025-09-12.txt

matt: Good catch. Lina, can you replace the slide with a single bar that shows both numbers (MT: 18% / LT: 3.2%) and an abbreviated note: "MT captures multi-touch influence; LT used in faster BI export". Keep it visually simple.

lina: On it. Also adding a footnote: "Week impacted by GA sampling throttle (see analytics)."

oscar: Long-term, we should move deck generation to a cached dashboard snapshot flow so slides pull the canonical numbers. I'll open a ticket.

priya: For routing: since multi-touch shows webinar as a bigger contributor, we should consider temporarily routing more inbound MQLs from webinar tag to SDRs for 2 weeks to capitalize on the uplift. Can we estimate the lift in qualified leads?

analytics-bot: Quick calc: if webinar contributes 18% of 1200 leads last week = 216 leads. Historical conv rate to MQL from webinar cohort = 11% -> ~24 MQLs. Last-touch shows 3.2% = 38 leads -> ~4 MQLs. Difference ~20 MQLs/week.

priya: That's a meaningful delta. Recommend we route an extra SDR capacity for 2 weeks and monitor conversion.

matt: Agree. Also please add an experiment note on the KPI slide: "Routing bump (2w) to test higher-touch response to webinar leads".

lina: Slide updated, replaced stacked bar with MT/LT pair and added experiment note and sampling footnote. Uploading new deck now.

oscar: Ticket opened: #PROJ-482 deck canonicalization flow. Linking analytics owner.

priya: Perfect. We'll cover it in the KPI review and decide on SDR reallocation after the first week. Thanks all.
